purpose: Test the decision-only PSD mixed-discriminant shortcut. Mixed-discriminant positivity for PSD tuples is polynomial via the Rado/Edmonds rank criterion even though exact evaluation is #P-hard. Prove that the exact local rank-3 switch support cannot be replaced by PSD principal-minor positivity, because PSD principal-minor support is matroidal while the switch is not.

positive_reference.fact: For PSD matrices A_1,...,A_n, D(A_1,...,A_n)>0 iff rank(sum_{i in T} A_i)>=|T| for every T; this is a Rado/Edmonds matroid-intersection condition and gives deterministic polynomial zero-testing.
positive_reference.importance: This separates decision from exact counting and would be sufficient for P=NP if the source carrier admitted an exact polynomial PSD lift.

theorem.name: PSD_POSITIVE_PRINCIPAL_MINOR_SUPPORT_IS_MATROIDAL_AND_CANNOT_EQUAL_RANK3_SWITCH
proof: If H is Hermitian PSD, write H=X*X. For every index set S, H[S,S]=X_S* X_S and det H[S,S]>0 iff the columns indexed by S are linearly independent.
Hence the family P(H)={S:det H[S,S]>0} is exactly the independent-set family of a representable matroid.
The switch family R={empty,{L},{M},{R},{L,R}} violates matroid augmentation: I={M}, J={L,R}, |I|<|J|, but neither I union {L} nor I union {R} lies in R.
Therefore no Hermitian PSD matrix, in any representation with one visible element per occurrence, has positive-principal-minor support equal to the exact switch family.
theorem.fixed_padding_corollary: Adding a fixed mandatory independent auxiliary set and testing positivity of the enlarged principal minor only contracts the ambient representable matroid; contraction is still a matroid. Therefore fixed mandatory PSD padding cannot repair the five-state visible support.
direct_3x3_corollary: Suppose a real symmetric H had exactly the source 3x3 principal minors. Singleton minors force h_LL=h_MM=h_RR=1.
LM=0 and MR=0 force h_LM^2=h_MR^2=1. LR=1 forces h_LR=0.
Then det H=1-h_LM^2-h_MR^2+2 h_LM h_MR h_LR=-1, contradicting the required LMR minor 0. Thus even symmetry without PSD is impossible for the exact local principal-minor data.

killed: Replace each non-Hermitian P0 switch block by a PSD/Hermitian block with the same zero/nonzero principal-minor semantics and invoke mixed-discriminant positivity.
The same plan with any fixed mandatory PSD auxiliary padding whose visible acceptance is principal-minor positivity.
not_killed: A genuinely global formula-dependent PSD construction that does not preserve each local switch as one principal-minor support relation.
Bilinear/non-Hermitian rank factorizations and oriented matroid-parity style contractions.
